#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

bool in(const vector<int>& a, int b, int l, int r) {
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        if (a[i] == b) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

int fun(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
    if ((r - l + 1) > 2 * (a + b)) {
        if (a <= b)
            return a + 1;
        else
            return 2 * a - b;
    }

    vector<int> flag(3 * (a + b) + 1, 0);
    int temp = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= a; ++i) {
        flag[i] = i;
        temp = i;
    }

    for (int i = a + 1; i <= a + b; ++i) {
        flag[i] = temp;
    }

    for (int i = a + b + 1; i <= a + b + a; ++i) {
        int tc = 1;
        while (in(flag, tc, a + b - a + 1, i - 1))
            tc++;
        flag[i] = tc;
        temp = flag[i];
    }

    for (int i = a + b + a + 1; i <= a + b + a + b; ++i) {
        flag[i] = temp;
    }

    for (int i = 2 * (a + b) + 1; i <= 3 * (a + b); ++i) {
        flag[i] = flag[i - (a + b)];
    }

    vector<int> flagc(25, 0);
    int templ = l % (a + b);
    if (templ == 0) templ += a + b;
    int tempr = r - l + templ;
    if (tempr < templ) tempr += a + b;

    for (int i = templ; i <= tempr; ++i) {
        flagc[flag[i]] = 1;
    }

    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 24; ++i)
        res += flagc[i];

    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;

    cout << fun(a, b, l, r) << endl;

    return 0;
}
